svg.title: How revit-mcp is put together
svg.desc: An AI client speaks MCP over stdio to a Node server on the same machine, which speaks HTTP over loopback to a C# add-in inside Revit, which uses the Revit API on Revit's own thread. Blender is an optional local renderer.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Revit API lives inside Revit and is single-threaded, so the AI protocol and the model are kept apart.
